newsitem.title: USA: Scandinavian Broadcast sells part of unit.
newsitem.headline: Scandinavian Broadcast sells part of unit.

text.p: Scandinavian Broadcasting Systems SA said Tuesday it sold to A-Pressen, a Norwegian company an additional 16 percent of its Norwegian television station called TV Norge.
SBS said it now owns 51 percent of the station.
The company said the purchase is in connection with a definitive agreement between TV Norge and TV2, Norway's other national television station, to cooperate in programming, promotion and scheduling.
The company said A-Pressen, which had already acquired an interest in the station, now owns 20 percent of it. The other 29 percent is owned by Schibsted AS.
The company said, however, that TV2 is expected to buy a 33 percent ownership interest in TV Norge by buying a percentage of shares owned by Schibsted and A-Pressen.
Schibsted and A-Pressen own more than half of the outstanding shares of TV2.
